name: Homogeneous Earthfill Embankment Dam
title: Homogeneous Earthfill Embankment Dam
description: Homogeneous Earthfill Embankment Dam is a complete embankment dam blueprint record in this database, covering the full plan set from site layout to final details. The design calls for 80 ft high dam with 600 ft crest, 3:1 upstream and 2.5:1 downstream slopes, built from Compacted clay core with filter zones. Core keyed into impervious foundation. Settlement monuments on crest. The plan sheets include zoning cross-section sheets, filter and drain details, and spillway and outlet plans. Taught at ladder rank 1 of 20 (Foundations): core concepts, parts, and safe building practices. Signature-line original design by the JAH system; verify against local codes before building.
dimensions: 80 ft high dam with 600 ft crest, 3:1 upstream and 2.5:1 downstream slopes
materials: Compacted clay core with filter zones
structural_notes: Core keyed into impervious foundation. Settlement monuments on crest.
